meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后,当要求写提交信息时,Claude 会把 Conventional Commits 格式的简短信息放进代码块:主题形如 `fix(api): 摘要`,祈使语气、≤72字符;仅必要时加正文(破坏性变更、迁移、关联 issue);不执行 git 命令。
howto.when: 当要求写提交信息,或输入 /commit、/caveman-commit 时触发。

say.text: write a commit: 修复登录页崩溃
commit message: 处理 API 破坏性变更
say.note: 会加正文,注明 BREAKING CHANGE 和迁移说明。
退出该模式,改回普通的详细提交风格。

howto.what_en: When asked to write a commit message, Claude emits a code block with a terse Conventional Commits message: a subject like `fix(api): summary` (imperative mood, ≤72 chars), plus a body only when needed for breaking changes, migrations, or linked issues. It never runs git commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a commit message is requested, or when /commit or /caveman-commit is entered.

say_en.text: write a commit: fix the login crash
say_en.note: Outputs a terse Conventional Commits message.

say_en.text: commit message: handle the breaking API change
say_en.note: Adds a body with BREAKING CHANGE and migration notes.
Exits caveman mode back to verbose commit style.
